title: Verb content (combined, per verb/locale)
description: One document per verb per locale. Semantic component keys (howTo, faq) are OMITTED entirely when the page has no such component (never null or empty), so they map directly onto the consumer's .optional() fields. `blocks` and `linkReferences` are always present and carry the full, raw document so nothing is dropped.

schemaVersion.description: SemVer of THIS schema. MAJOR = breaking shape change, MINOR = additive key, PATCH = non-structural fix. Loaders should branch on the MAJOR.

verb.description: Verb id, e.g. "word-to-pdf". Cross-checked against the page's Rnr block.

howTo.description: Sourced from the DA "How To" block. Omitted when the page has no How To block.

intro.description: Intro paragraphs as inline HTML, in order.

video.description: Omitted when the How To block carries no video line.

posterUrl.description: Poster image, resolved from the reference-style image definition.

faq.description: Sourced from the plain DA "Accordion" block (no variant). Omitted when the page has no such block or it is empty.

blocks.description: Every parsed block in document order, verbatim — a raw catch-all so nothing is dropped, including blocks with no semantic key (Text, Icon Block, Media, Columns, Section Metadata, Rnr, …). Cell content is RAW Markdown, not rendered HTML.

section.description: 0-based index of the `---`-delimited section this block belongs to.

name.description: Block name, e.g. "How To", "Icon Block", "Section Metadata".

rows.description: Data rows (header row excluded). Each row is an array of raw-Markdown cells, one per column.

linkReferences.description: Reference-style link/image definitions (`[label]: url`) collected from the whole file, so raw block rows using `![alt][label]` remain resolvable. Empty object when the file has none.
